[[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] '''Thaneespi''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. After the [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|invasion]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she became a leader of the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from the planet. Thaneespi went on to serve as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], participating in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as one of the [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officers]] on the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], which led the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].

==Biography==
A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]],<ref name="DB" /> Thaneespi was one of the leaders of the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|invasion]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. She became a [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] and tactical analyst, stationed aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']]<ref name="CCG" /> of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> At that [[Time/Legends|time]], she held the position of [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]].<ref name="CCG" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], she briefly conversed with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] on the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|starship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[File:Thaneespi-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Thaneespi and Admiral Ackbar]]
During the subsequent [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], Thaneespi served on ''Home One'',<ref name="DB" /> the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of the Alliance Fleet. The battle resulted in the destruction of the Galactic Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Personality and traits==
Thaneespi was one of several brave leaders of the Mon Calamari refugees after the Empire invaded Dac, her homeworld. She had [[Color/Legends|brown-mottled]] skin<ref name="DB" /> and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Thaneespi's name was literally translated as "of many hearts," although its meaning was unclear.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Thaneespi was a brilliant tactical analyst. She was also [[Force-attunement|Force-attuned]].<ref name="CCG" />

==Equipment==
Thaneespi wore a [[Mon Calamari helmet|helmet]] of a type worn by high ranking Mon Calamari [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] housed a [[Comm unit/Legends|communications device]] and offered moderate protection. She also carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] which had its trigger guard removed to allow for handling by Mon Calamari fingers.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Thaneespi.jpg|250px|thumb|Thaneespi from the card that first named her]]
Thaneespi first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> The scenes on ''Home One'' were filmed throughout the week of Tuesday, [[February 16]], [[1982]].<ref name="BTS">{{WebCite|url=https://swnz.co.nz/2017/03/11/gerald-home-tessek-squid-head-mon-calamari-officer-2|text=Gerald Home as Tessek (Squid Head) and Mon Calamari Officer|author=G., Matt|date=2004-06-11|work=[https://swnz.co.nz Star Wars New Zealand]|archivedate=20190724024037}}</ref> Thaneespi's helmet was originally intended to be worn by Admiral Ackbar, but it was given to her instead seeing as Ackbar's articulated head did not allow for the helmet to be used.<ref name="costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> [[Peter Ronzani|Pete Ronzani]] and his team were responsible for designing the helmet.<ref name="Mythe">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref>

She was first identified in the ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], released in [[2000]].<ref name="CCG" /> Thaneespi's [[Hasbro]] action figure from the ''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]'' toy line, also released in 2000, which was titled "Mon Calamari officer," has two images of Mon Calamari on its packaging; while one of them correctly shows Thaneespi, the other is of<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Verrack/Legends|Verrack]].<ref name="Verrack">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Verrack}}</ref>
